Hi Diego / Priyom,

Thanks for the walkthrough last week. BrightCloud is excited to move forward with the AWS Channel Private Offer (CPPO) — we have a handful of items to confirm on our side before we can sign the reseller agreement: 

- Primary billing entity: BrightCloud US (EIN 12-3456789) — need to confirm Redwood can invoice under that name.
- Marketplace listing timeline: target go-live window is May 10–14.
- SKU mapping: we will provide mapping from our bundles to AWS SKUs; please confirm format.
- Compliance evidence: our SOC2 report is with ops@brightcloud.com (attached).

Attached: BrightCloud_Reseller_Profile.pdf (stub)

Can we do a 30-min call tomorrow to align next steps? Availability: 10–12 PST.

Best,
Laura Mason
Head of Partnerships
BrightCloud Inc.
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Laura Mason <laura@brightcloud.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CPPO readiness and reseller governance checklist — BrightCloud

Laura — thanks for the clear list. Quick responses and suggested action items from our side: 

1) Billing entity / invoicing
   - We can invoice BrightCloud US. Ben (cc'd) will confirm billing flow and whether AWS settlement will require a separate entity mapping.

2) Marketplace listing timeline
   - May 10–14 looks feasible if we complete the CPPO paperwork and SKU mapping by Apr 16. Proposed timeline:
     • Apr 6–9: collect PO template, tax docs, and signed CPPO terms
     • Apr 12: Redwood submits Private Offer to AWS for review
     • Apr 20: expected sandbox approval (AWS review windows vary)

3) SKU mapping & technical metadata
   - We prefer CSV with columns: BrightCloudSKU, RedwoodSKU, AWS_SkuId, UnitPrice, BillingCycle. Priyom will share a template.

4) Compliance evidence
   - OK on SOC2 stub — ops@brightcloud, please ensure a downloadable link or PDF to attach to the marketplace evidentiary package.

5) Next steps / kickoff
   - 30-min call tomorrow at 10:30 PST works for Priyom and me. Ben will join for billing/PO questions.

Attached: none (referencing BrightCloud profile received)

Action items (owner):
- Laura: confirm PO template + attach SOC2 link (by Apr 9)
- Priyom: send SKU mapping CSV template (by EOD Apr 5)
- Ben: confirm invoice flow and required legal Docs (by Apr 8)

Thanks — talk tomorrow.

— Diego
Director, Business Development
Redwood Inference

Diego / team — quick finance notes from my side after checking with ops: 

- Invoice entity: we can invoice BrightCloud US directly. For AWS settlement, we will map BrightCloud's AWS account ID to the CPPO enrollment record; that mapping is required to ensure credits/commissions flow.
- PO info: please use our standard PO template (link below) and include the Redwood account code in Box 7.
- Tax docs: we need W-9 from BrightCloud if invoicing in the US.

I will open a DocuSign for the CPPO terms draft once Diego confirms the final version. I flagged the billing mapping as high priority — it blocks entitlements.

Links: https://docs.redwood.com/templates/po-template

Ben Carter
